body.name: \(\operatorname{Enum}_G\)
body.construction: Precompute \(\beta(A,r)\) for every full-lattice edge \(A\to A\cup\{r\}\). Separately for each original row label, sort these finite exact-real rows lexicographically and intern equal rows as one integer identifier. Set \(H_{\varnothing}=\{F_{\varnothing}\}\). Process all subsets by cardinality and, for every \(F\in H_A\) and every \(r\in V\setminus A\), write the interned identifier of \(\beta(A,r)\) into slot \(r\) and insert the resulting integer vector into a deterministic binary trie for \(H_{A\cup\{r\}}\) only if absent. Emit every decoded member of \(H_V\) once. Construction followed by source-to-sink pruning of the full lattice is permitted; the pruning is vacuous because every subset lies on a source-to-sink path.
